name: camayoc_github_default_branch_ci
description: github-activity Q4: for repository <repo>, the conclusion, head commit and time of the latest completed run of each workflow on branch <branch>. Answers gh-ci-watch's question from facts instead of a gh run list poll.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT DISTINCT ?workflow ?conclusion ?head ?at WHERE { GRAPH ?g0 { ?repo aegis:githubFullName "{repo}" . } GRAPH ?g { ?a aegis:githubEventKind "workflow_run.completed" ; aegis:inGitHubRepository ?repo ; aegis:aboutGitHubEntity ?run ; aegis:githubBaseRef "{branch}" ; aegis:githubConclusion ?conclusion ; aegis:commitSha ?head ; aegis:occurredAt ?at . } GRAPH ?g2 { ?run aegis:githubName ?workflow . } FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH ?g3 { ?b aegis:githubEventKind "workflow_run.completed" ; aegis:inGitHubRepository ?repo ; aegis:aboutGitHubEntity ?run2 ; aegis:githubBaseRef "{branch}" ; aegis:occurredAt ?at2 . } GRAPH ?g4 { ?run2 aegis:githubName ?workflow . } FILTER(?at2 > ?at) } } ORDER BY ?workflow
